title: YouTube Video 1
description: A video-led case study emphasizing pacing and on-screen narrative.

details.overview: The piece is structured for clarity on both mobile and desktop, keeping the story readable even when attention is short.
details.challenge: Video case studies lose impact when pacing and on-screen hierarchy fight the narrative.
details.solution: A paced layout with clear chaptering and responsive framing keeps the story intact across devices.
features: Narrative pacing for short attention spans
